headline: The shelf ran dry — and it stayed honest
lede: Slot b worked the full ladder end to end and found nothing to build: the warden's target (#3086, papercraft polish) was held live by QA mini, the queue labels are empty, and a README-by-README sweep of all 66 titles shows zero unowned gaps. Every flagship roadmap item is CLOSED, BLOCKED, or a DISCLAIMER. This is the first fully dry shelf — and the dry-shelf question Jon answered on Nov 20 already put DOUBLE DRAGON and R-TYPE on the shelf, both now shipped gap-free.

notes.text: No ship from slot b: target #3086 refused at claim (mini holds it live), ladder empty, flagship stage and never-dry rung both null across the shelf. Legal dry-shelf stop per #1571, verified by reading READMEs, not trusting parsers.
TIDY BOT has two lanes inside it tonight — mini (holder) and slot a's unclaimed local branch. The liveness namespace can't see an unclaimed build (#3072); whoever opens the PR first owns it.
jonq's 7-day title cap correctly refused a fresh dry-shelf ask: #2795 was answered this week. Re-ask is legal Nov 27 — only if the shelf is still dry.
